title: Engram-contract changes should run the pinned live suite before their own commit, not only in the landing train
outcome: A change to Engram admission or another Engram contract path changed behaviour that the ignored live tests assert, but its own full gate does not run `live`. So the break surfaced only in the landing train's live run, after its pair. Add a pinned live run (`node scripts/test-launcher.mjs live --engram-binary ... --engram-sha256 ...`) to the author's pre-commit checklist for Engram-contract changes, for example in docs/test.md or the landing method, so stale live assertions are caught on the author's branch.
acceptance: Engram-contract changes should run the pinned live suite before their own commit, not only in the landing train is done
